problems.title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
problems.notes: subset-sum-as-knapsack: target = totalSum/2, dp[t] = can we hit exactly t using each number once

problems.title: Target Sum
problems.notes: reframe +/- assignment as subset-sum knapsack: P - N = target and P + N = total, solve for the positive subset sum

problems.title: Last Stone Weight II
problems.notes: minimize |sumA - sumB| by finding the subset sum closest to total/2 via 0/1 knapsack

problems.title: Ones and Zeroes
problems.notes: 2D knapsack capacity (zeros budget, ones budget) — extends the 1D DP to two simultaneous constraints

problems.title: Partition to K Equal Sum Subsets
problems.notes: backtracking with a bucket-fill mindset, or bitmask DP over subset states — generalizes Partition Equal Subset Sum to k groups

problems.title: Solving Questions With Brainpower
problems.notes: 0/1 knapsack shaped as 'take or skip with a cooldown' — solving question i locks out the next brainpower[i] questions

problems.title: Length of the Longest Subsequence That Sums to Target
problems.notes: 0/1 knapsack where the DP tracks max subsequence length per achievable sum, not just feasibility

problems.title: Ways to Express an Integer as Sum of Powers
problems.notes: 0/1 knapsack counting ways: items are x-th powers of 1..n, each usable at most once, count subsets summing to n

problems.title: Profitable Schemes
problems.notes: 3D 0/1 knapsack (people used, profit achieved) with a 'cap profit at target' trick to keep the state space bounded
